answer_1.quote: Step‑by‑step FTRs resembling an "inner‑monologue" are generated using an LLM (teacher model) conditioned on the gold coreference label.

answer_2.quote: Self‑BLEU scores of the generated rationales for each corpus are reported, indicating lexical diversity and similarity.

answer_4.quote: Four evaluators (all adult English speakers) took a survey containing pairs of event mentions ... The questions were: New Information Relevance, Gold Label, Plausibility, Inner Speech Overlap.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators answered a set of questions assessing relevance, adequacy of information, plausibility, and overlap with their own reasoning.
